sentence: This project studies a protein that blocks interferon signals in cancer to find out how interferon can better fight tumor growth.
This project builds machine learning methods that use images from handheld ultrasound devices to help diagnose aortic stenosis, a heart valve condition.
This project uses computer vision to study how facial expressions and other nonverbal social behaviors differ in autism and anxiety.
This project builds a toolkit to work with images of pediatric brain tumors and help make models that predict patient outcomes.
This project studies real world problems in reproductive, perinatal, and pediatric health.
This project builds flexible radiofrequency detectors and other sensors for MRI scanners, plus computational tools that check safety.
This project provides small animal imaging and tissue slide analysis to help study digestive diseases in animals and humans.
This project tests ways to treat endometrial cancer by targeting replication stress, alone or together with drugs that help the immune system.
This project supports tuberculosis research with computational models, statistics and analysis of genome-scale data.
This project studies how mutations in a protein that controls many genes cause autism spectrum disorder, using human neurons and mouse experiments.
This project studies the gene network in an early lung progenitor cell that leads to different types of respiratory epithelial cells.
This project tries to find out how a rare chromosomal change causes a type of pediatric acute myeloid leukemia, using CRISPR.
This project tries to find out how placental growth factor causes retinal damage in diabetes by changing glucose metabolism.
This project studies how the electron transport chain in mitochondria is controlled in podocytes and whether it drives diabetic kidney disease.
This project builds computational models to predict and improve reactions that use organic radical intermediates.
This project tests in a mouse screening platform whether different mutations in one gene change how severe tuberous sclerosis is.
This project uses deep learning to speed up knee MRI scans and to automatically find osteoarthritis changes in the images.
This project studies which cellular and physical changes keep muscle from regrowing after critical illness.
This project studies the genetics of how human coronary arteries form, including natural bypass arteries called collaterals.
This project provides data management, bioinformatics analysis and statistics help to a group of research projects.
